description: This Java source file defines a Fragment subclass called LogFragment used for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages a custom LogView component embedded inside a ScrollView, providing UI layout setup and text change handling.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that hosts a LogView widget within a ScrollView, allowing for log message display and automatic scrolling when new logs are added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView components, sets layout parameters, styles, and padding, then returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, attaches a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the view for display.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
